prompt.en: The sandbox has an in-memory MongoDB. In script.js: import `{ MongoClient }` from "mongodb", connect to `mongodb://localhost:27017/syntax`, and insert two documents into the `todos` collection of the `app` database: `{ text: 'write code', done: false }` and `{ text: 'review', done: false }`. Store the count of documents in the collection after the insert in `globalThis.result` (use `countDocuments()`).
prompt.ru: В песочнице есть в-memory MongoDB. В script.js: импортируй `{ MongoClient }` из "mongodb", подключись к `mongodb://localhost:27017/syntax` и вставь два документа в коллекцию `todos` базы `app`: `{ text: 'write code', done: false }` и `{ text: 'review', done: false }`. Сохрани количество документов в коллекции после вставки в `globalThis.result` (через `countDocuments()`).

tests.name: result is 2
tests.code: assert(globalThis.result === 2, "expected globalThis.result === 2, got " + globalThis.result);

tests.name: documents stored
tests.code: const docs = window.__db.mongo['todos'] || []; assert(Array.isArray(docs) && docs.length === 2, "expected 2 docs in the 'todos' collection, got " + docs.length);

hint.en: const coll = client.db('app').collection('todos'); await coll.insertMany([...]); const n = await coll.countDocuments();
hint.ru: const coll = client.db('app').collection('todos'); await coll.insertMany([...]); const n = await coll.countDocuments();

prompt.en: The `users` collection is pre-populated in the sandbox (5 users with `name`, `age`, `city`). Find all users from "Berlin" and store them in `globalThis.result` sorted by age ascending (use `find(filter).sort({ age: 1 }).toArray()`).
prompt.ru: Коллекция `users` посеяна в песочнице (5 пользователей с `name`, `age`, `city`). Найди всех пользователей из "Berlin" и сохрани в `globalThis.result` отсортированными по возрасту по возрастанию (используй `find(filter).sort({ age: 1 }).toArray()`).

setup: const client = new (globalThis.__shims.mongodb.MongoClient)('mongodb://localhost:27017/syntax'); await client.connect(); const coll = client.db('app').collection('users'); await coll.insertMany([{ name: 'Anna', age: 34, city: 'Berlin' }, { name: 'Ben', age: 28, city: 'Berlin' }, { name: 'Cara', age: 41, city: 'Paris' }, { name: 'Dan', age: 25, city: 'Berlin' }, { name: 'Eva', age: 30, city: 'Rome' }]);

tests.name: 3 berlin users sorted by age
tests.code:
const r = globalThis.result; assert(Array.isArray(r) && r.length === 3, "expected 3 users, got " + (r && r.length));
assert(JSON.stringify(r.map((u) => u.age)) === JSON.stringify([25, 28, 34]), "expected ages [25, 28, 34] in order, got " + JSON.stringify(r && r.map((u) => u.age)));

tests.name: all from Berlin
tests.code: assert(globalThis.result.every((u) => u.city === 'Berlin'), "all results must be from Berlin");

prompt.en: The `products` collection is pre-populated (documents: { name, price, stock }). Find products where `price` is greater than 50 AND `stock` is at least 5: use the `$gt` and `$gte` operators in one filter. Store the result (names only is fine — store the whole documents) in `globalThis.result` sorted by name.
prompt.ru: Коллекция `products` посеяна (документы: { name, price, stock }). Найди товары, где `price` больше 50 И `stock` не меньше 5: используй операторы `$gt` и `$gte` в одном фильтре. Результат (целиком, документы) — в `globalThis.result`, отсортированный по имени.

setup: const client = new (globalThis.__shims.mongodb.MongoClient)('mongodb://localhost:27017/syntax'); await client.connect(); const coll = client.db('app').collection('products'); await coll.insertMany([{ name: 'Keyboard', price: 80, stock: 12 }, { name: 'Mouse', price: 30, stock: 40 }, { name: 'Monitor', price: 250, stock: 3 }, { name: 'Webcam', price: 60, stock: 5 }, { name: 'Hub', price: 25, stock: 8 }]);

tests.name: filter correct
tests.code: const names = (globalThis.result || []).map((p) => p.name); assert(JSON.stringify(names) === JSON.stringify(['Keyboard', 'Webcam']), "expected ['Keyboard','Webcam'], got " + JSON.stringify(names));

tests.name: monitor excluded (stock)
tests.code: const r = globalThis.result; assert(!r.some((p) => p.name === 'Monitor'), "Monitor must be excluded (stock < 5)");

hint.en: Filter operators: { price: { $gt: 50 }, stock: { $gte: 5 } } — AND between fields.
hint.ru: Операторы фильтра: { price: { $gt: 50 }, stock: { $gte: 5 } } — AND между полями.

prompt.en: In the pre-populated `tasks` collection (3 tasks with `title` and `status: 'open'`) mark the task with title "Ship it" as done: `updateOne({ title: 'Ship it' }, { $set: { status: 'done' } })`. Store in `globalThis.result` the `status` of that task after the update (read it back with `findOne`).
prompt.ru: В посеянной коллекции `tasks` (3 задачи с `title` и `status: 'open'`) пометь задачу с title "Ship it" как выполненную: `updateOne({ title: 'Ship it' }, { $set: { status: 'done' } })`. В `globalThis.result` сохрани `status` этой задачи после обновления (прочитай через `findOne`).

setup: const client = new (globalThis.__shims.mongodb.MongoClient)('mongodb://localhost:27017/syntax'); await client.connect(); const coll = client.db('app').collection('tasks'); await coll.insertMany([{ title: 'Design', status: 'open' }, { title: 'Ship it', status: 'open' }, { title: 'Review', status: 'open' }]);

tests.name: status updated
tests.code: assert(globalThis.result === 'done', "expected 'done', got " + globalThis.result);

tests.name: others untouched
tests.code: const others = (window.__db.mongo['tasks'] || []).filter((d) => d.title === 'Design'); assert(others.length === 1 && others[0].status === 'open', "other tasks must stay 'open'");

hint.en: $set updates only the given fields — the document keeps the rest.
hint.ru: $set обновляет только указанные поля — документ сохраняет остальное.

prompt.en: The `logs` collection is pre-populated with 6 documents: 2 with `level: 'error'`, 4 with `level: 'info'`. Delete all error logs (`deleteMany`) and store in `globalThis.result` the remaining document count (it must be 4, all 'info').
prompt.ru: Коллекция `logs` посеяна 6 документами: 2 с `level: 'error'` и 4 с `level: 'info'`. Удали все error-логи (`deleteMany`) и сохрани в `globalThis.result` количество оставшихся документов (должно быть 4, все 'info').

setup: const client = new (globalThis.__shims.mongodb.MongoClient)('mongodb://localhost:27017/syntax'); await client.connect(); const coll = client.db('app').collection('logs'); await coll.insertMany([{ level: 'info', msg: 'a' }, { level: 'error', msg: 'b' }, { level: 'info', msg: 'c' }, { level: 'error', msg: 'd' }, { level: 'info', msg: 'e' }, { level: 'info', msg: 'f' }]);

files.script.js:
import { MongoClient } from "mongodb";

// TODO: deleteMany({ level: 'error' }) + globalThis.result = countDocuments()

tests.name: 4 left
tests.code: assert(globalThis.result === 4, "expected 4 documents left, got " + globalThis.result);

tests.name: no errors left
tests.code: const errs = (window.__db.mongo['logs'] || []).filter((d) => d.level === 'error'); assert(errs.length === 0, "expected 0 error logs");

hint.en: deleteMany(filter) — removes all matching documents; countDocuments() after.
hint.ru: deleteMany(filter) — удаляет все подходящие документы; после — countDocuments().

prompt.en: The `orders` collection is pre-populated with 4 documents { amount, status: 'paid' | 'open' }. Build an aggregation pipeline: group by `status` and sum `amount` ($sum: '$amount'), output `{ _id: status, total: … }`. Store the result of the paid group (its `total`) in `globalThis.result`.
prompt.ru: Коллекция `orders` посеяна 4 документами { amount, status: 'paid' | 'open' }. Собери агрегационный конвейер: сгруппируй по `status` и посуммируй `amount` ($sum: '$amount'), вывод `{ _id: status, total: … }`. В `globalThis.result` сохрани `total` для группы paid.

setup: const client = new (globalThis.__shims.mongodb.MongoClient)('mongodb://localhost:27017/syntax'); await client.connect(); const coll = client.db('app').collection('orders'); await coll.insertMany([{ amount: 100, status: 'paid' }, { amount: 50, status: 'paid' }, { amount: 30, status: 'open' }, { amount: 20, status: 'open' }]);

tests.name: paid total is 150
tests.code: assert(globalThis.result === 150, "expected 150, got " + globalThis.result);

tests.name: open group total is 50
tests.code: const orders = (window.__db.mongo['orders'] || []).filter((d) => d.status === 'open'); assert(orders.reduce((s, o) => s + o.amount, 0) === 50, "sanity: open orders sum to 50");

hint.en: coll.aggregate([{ $group: { _id: '$status', total: { $sum: '$amount' } } }]).toArray() — then find the group with _id 'paid'.
hint.ru: coll.aggregate([{ $group: { _id: '$status', total: { $sum: '$amount' } } }]).toArray() — потом бери группу с _id 'paid'.

prompt.en: The `events` collection is pre-populated (documents { type, user }). Find the 3 most frequent event `type`s: pipeline — group by `type` counting (`_id: '$type', n: { $sum: 1 }`), sort by `n` descending, limit to 3. Store in `globalThis.result` an array of the types in that order (e.g. `['click', 'view', 'like']`).
prompt.ru: Коллекция `events` посеяна (документы { type, user }). Найди 3 самых частых `type` событий: конвейер — группируй по `type` со счётчиком (`_id: '$type', n: { $sum: 1 }`), сортируй по `n` по убыванию, ограничение 3. В `globalThis.result` — массив типов в этом порядке (например, `['click', 'view', 'like']`).

setup: const client = new (globalThis.__shims.mongodb.MongoClient)('mongodb://localhost:27017/syntax'); await client.connect(); const coll = client.db('app').collection('events'); await coll.insertMany([{ type: 'click' }, { type: 'click' }, { type: 'click' }, { type: 'view' }, { type: 'view' }, { type: 'like' }, { type: 'share' }]);

tests.name: top 3 in order
tests.code: assert(JSON.stringify(globalThis.result) === JSON.stringify(['click', 'view', 'like']), "expected ['click','view','like'], got " + JSON.stringify(globalThis.result));

tests.name: top list is at most 3
tests.code: const r = globalThis.result; assert(Array.isArray(r) && r.length <= 3 && r[0] === 'click', "top must start with 'click' and be <= 3, got " + JSON.stringify(r));

hint.en: $sum: 1 counts documents in the group; $sort { n: -1 }; $limit 3; then map _id.
hint.ru: $sum: 1 считает документы в группе; $sort { n: -1 }; $limit 3; потом мапишь _id.

prompt.en: The `posts` collection is pre-populated: documents { title, author: { name }, tags: [ … ] }. Find posts where the author's name is "Ada" or "Linus" (`$in` on the nested field `author.name`) AND the tags contain "web" (use the array containment: `tags: 'web'`). Store the titles in `globalThis.result` sorted alphabetically.
prompt.ru: Коллекция `posts` посеяна: документы { title, author: { name }, tags: [ … ] }. Найди посты, где имя автора (вложенное поле `author.name`) — "Ada" или "Linus" (`$in`) И теги содержат "web" (содержание в массиве: `tags: 'web'`). Заголовки — в `globalThis.result`, отсортированные по алфавиту.

setup: const client = new (globalThis.__shims.mongodb.MongoClient)('mongodb://localhost:27017/syntax'); await client.connect(); const coll = client.db('app').collection('posts'); await coll.insertMany([{ title: 'Web perf', author: { name: 'Ada' }, tags: ['web', 'perf'] }, { title: 'Databases', author: { name: 'Ada' }, tags: ['db'] }, { title: 'CSS grid', author: { name: 'Linus' }, tags: ['css', 'web'] }, { title: 'Kernels', author: { name: 'Linus' }, tags: ['os'] }, { title: 'Intro', author: { name: 'Grace' }, tags: ['web'] }]);

tests.name: correct titles
tests.code: assert(JSON.stringify(globalThis.result) === JSON.stringify(['CSS grid', 'Web perf']), "expected ['CSS grid','Web perf'], got " + JSON.stringify(globalThis.result));

tests.name: Grace excluded
tests.code: const r = globalThis.result || []; assert(!r.includes('Intro'), "Grace's post must not match (author not in list)");

hint.en: Dotted notation for nested fields: 'author.name'. `tags: 'web'` matches arrays that contain 'web'.
hint.ru: Точечная нотация для вложенных полей: 'author.name'. `tags: 'web'` матчит массивы, содержащие 'web'.

prompt.en: The `counters` collection starts empty. Use `updateOne` with `upsert: true` to set the counter: `updateOne({ key: 'visits' }, { $setOnInsert: { key: 'visits' }, $inc: { count: 1 } }, { upsert: true })` — run this update three times, then read the counter and store its `count` in `globalThis.result` (it must be 3).
prompt.ru: Коллекция `counters` пуста. Используй `updateOne` с `upsert: true`, чтобы завести счётчик: `updateOne({ key: 'visits' }, { $setOnInsert: { key: 'visits' }, $inc: { count: 1 } }, { upsert: true })` — выполни это обновление три раза, затем прочитай счётчик и сохрани его `count` в `globalThis.result` (должно быть 3).

tests.name: count is 3
tests.code: assert(globalThis.result === 3, "expected 3, got " + globalThis.result);

tests.name: one document
tests.code: const docs = await (await (window.__db.mongo['counters'].find({})).toArray()); assert(docs.length === 1, "expected exactly 1 counter doc, got " + docs.length);

hint.en: upsert: true creates the document on the first $inc (count: undefined + 1 = 1), subsequent updates increment it.
hint.ru: upsert: true создаёт документ при первом $inc (count: undefined + 1 = 1), следующие обновления увеличивают.

prompt.en: The `scores` collection is pre-populated: { student, score }. Build a pipeline: `$match` score ≥ 70, then `$group` by `student` with the average (`avg: { $avg: '$score' }`), then `$sort` by `avg` descending. Store in `globalThis.result` the best student's name (the first document's `student`).
prompt.ru: Коллекция `scores` посеяна: { student, score }. Собери конвейер: `$match` score ≥ 70, затем `$group` по `student` со средним (`avg: { $avg: '$score' }`), затем `$sort` по `avg` по убыванию. В `globalThis.result` — имя лучшего студента (первый документ, поле `student`).

setup: const client = new (globalThis.__shims.mongodb.MongoClient)('mongodb://localhost:27017/syntax'); await client.connect(); const coll = client.db('app').collection('scores'); await coll.insertMany([{ student: 'Ada', score: 90 }, { student: 'Ada', score: 80 }, { student: 'Ben', score: 75 }, { student: 'Ben', score: 60 }, { student: 'Cara', score: 40 }]);

tests.name: best student is Ada
tests.code: assert(globalThis.result === 'Ada', "expected 'Ada', got " + globalThis.result);

tests.name: Ben average sanity
tests.code: const scores = (window.__db.mongo['scores'] || []).filter((s) => s.student === 'Ben' && s.score >= 70); assert(scores.length === 1 && scores[0].score === 75, "sanity: Ben's only passing score is 75");

hint.en: Cara is filtered out (40 < 70); Ben's average over the remaining (75) is less than Ada's (85).
hint.ru: Cara отфильтрована (40 < 70); среднее Ben по оставшимся (75) меньше среднего Ada (85).
